name: Takigawa
source:
The pride of Ohgiya, Takigawa is equaled in popularity in the pleasure district only by [url=https://vndb.org/c49852]Takao[/url] of Kikuya. Although he is the epitome of civility and plays no favorites, his true nature is an arrogant one. He is a little different somehow than other people, and in his time as a novice, he used that as a selling point.

(Edited from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
